_comment: Declarative registry of Hyly's BigQuery tables (ADR 0022).
Adding a future Hyly table should mean adding an entry here plus a rollup
SQL file — not editing hyly_client.py and shipping a Flask deploy.
tests/test_hyly_contract.py asserts every entry below still exists with the
declared columns, so vendor drift surfaces as a failing test rather than as
'access' records what the rpm-portal service account can actually reach as
of 2026-08-17 — 'granted' or 'blocked'. Blocked entries are skipped by the
contract test with a warning instead of failing the suite.
PROVENANCE (per Dylan Thompson, Hyly, 2026-08-10/14): the authoritative
vendor location for ALL FOUR tables is gds-prototype-20190629.rpm_living_nrt.
The copies in data-and-reporting-483421.hyly were made by RPM on 2026-08-11
(created == modified, never refreshed) and are a frozen snapshot, NOT a feed.
Hyly explicitly sanctions copying into our own project: 'Within your GCP,
you can migrate the shared tables to your specific project for review/
querying.' That is the landing-zone pattern, vendor-endorsed.

2026-08-18: Hyly granted the service account on gds-prototype-20190629.rpm_living_nrt (145 objects; 108 tables, 37 views — see docs/vendor/hyly/RPM_Living_NRT_Inventory.md). Their pipeline truncates and rebuilds in place, so many objects sit at 0 rows beside a *_bckup_ copy holding the data — which is why the 05:00 refresh guards against replacing a good local copy with an empty source.

sources.name: ga_hyly_mti
sources.table_meaning: 'mti' = multi-touch interaction (Hyly calls it 'our multi-touch table')
sources.grain: one row per (contact, event); milestone timestamps denormalised onto every row
sources.notes: Read from OUR landing copy, refreshed 05:00 daily from the vendor view. On Hyly's side ga_hyly_mti is a VIEW, so its metadata row count reads 0 — count at query time, never trust __TABLES__ for it.

sources.name: ga4_analytics_events
sources.grain: standard GA4 export enriched with Hyly org/property ids
sources.notes: 10.19 GB. NOT yet ingested. This is where visitors / known_visitors / UTM detail live; ingesting it is what restores the visitor half of the ADR 0015 contract. Never scan on a page load.

sources.name: prospect_journey
sources.grain: unknown - not yet readable by the service account
sources.notes: Service account granted 2026-08-18. Hyly's sample query: SELECT * FROM ... WHERE activity_dt BETWEEN DATETIME('2026-08-14') AND DATETIME('2026-08-15'). Project display name in Hyly's console is 'GoogleDataStudio'.

sources.name: t_crstal_events
sources.grain: unknown - not yet readable by the service account
sources.notes: Service account granted 2026-08-18. Sample query: WHERE TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(event_dt, MONTH) = TIMESTAMP('2026-08-01'). event_dt is a TIMESTAMP; prospect_journey's activity_dt is a DATETIME.
